source: data/derived/zip-governments.json (national TIGER lattice sampling), with each government's OCD id built from the Census names by lib/ocd/divisions.ts
note: Every division whose territory reaches each ZCTA, one shard per ZIP3. Not a claim that a reader at the ZIP is governed by all of them: `partial` lists those covering only part of the ZIP's sampled area (RULING 71). Committed OCD ids never move; a name collision elsewhere is suffixed with the Census GEOID.
